svg.title: 4A · Raka mislabels his sadness
svg.desc: Raka sits alone at his office desk, folded forward with his head lowered into both hands and both elbows on the tabletop after missing his target.
svg.metadata: Storyset Co-workers · Rafiki, Raka character. The original Raka illustration remains the base; the Agy frame guides the pose. The torso leans toward the desk, the head lowers into both hands, and the reshaped arms meet elbows at the tabletop. Target card and compact thought label are separate editable layers.
